pages.title: Besties Halloween Fashionista
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description:
Besties Halloween Fashionista is a dress-up game about preparing a group of friends for Halloween. Choose costumes, makeup, hairstyles, and seasonal accessories to create a finished look for the celebration. The styling options combine clothing with beauty choices rather than focusing on an outfit alone.

Try different combinations across the friends and use the spooky accessories to tie each appearance to the occasion. Your task is to assemble the Halloween looks, deciding how the costume, hair, and makeup work together.

pages.title: Turbo Horizon Racing
pages.creator: Breymantech
pages.description: Turbo Horizon Racing recreates retro arcade road racing with colorful pseudo-3D tracks. Steer through the course and use nitro to build speed, keeping the car positioned through the bends along the route.

pages.title: Car Factory For Kids
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Car Factory For Kids combines building a car with taking it onto a track. Assemble your chosen vehicle, then accelerate and brake through the driving activity. The construction choices give you a custom car to try in the race.

pages.title: Color Jam 3D
pages.creator: Hyper Rabbit Games
pages.description: Color Jam 3D turns crayon matching into a way to finish pictures. Send crayons into the available slots and match three of the same color to fill the artwork. Remove blocking pieces to free the crayons trapped behind them.

pages.title: Hot & Cold Winter Style
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Hot & Cold Winter Style follows Eliza and Milana on very different winter holidays. Dress Eliza for a snowy climate and style Milana for warm beaches, choosing clothing and accessories suited to each destination. Save the completed looks as pictures.

pages.title: Steal Car Duel
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Steal Car Duel turns collecting cars into a rivalry between players. Buy or steal vehicles to build your garage, earn coins and pursue upgrades while defending your collection. A second player can join the competition with separate movement and action controls.

pages.title: Bubble Tea
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Bubble Tea puts you behind the counter preparing colorful cold drinks. Read each order, choose ingredients and pour them into the cup without spilling. Finish the drink with a selected cup design and a decorative topper before serving it.

pages.title: LinkLink
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: LinkLink gives you one minute to score by connecting matching animal blocks. Slide through at least three of the same picture to remove them, looking for useful chains among the piled-up pieces before the time expires.

pages.title: Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Uncle Hit: Punch the Dummy centers on a series of dummy targets waiting for your punches. Tap the screen to strike them and keep the blows coming, reacting as the next targets appear in the action sequence.

pages.title: Addiction Mini Solitaire
pages.creator: Catafractum
pages.description: Addiction Mini Solitaire asks you to arrange cards from ace through six in matching-color sequences. Move a card into an empty space when it follows the card on its left. Use the single reshuffle when the arrangement needs another chance.

pages.title: Ocean Small Hospital Doctor
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Ocean Small Hospital Doctor turns a submarine into a clinic for sea animals. Find injured creatures in the ocean and bring them into the rescue-and-care activities, using the game's doctor role to help its underwater patients.

pages.title: Sprunki Lava Escape 2Player
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Sprunki Lava Escape 2Player sends two characters climbing above rising lava. Coordinate your jumps with a friend, collect musical notes along the way and keep gaining height. The endless route becomes dangerous whenever either character falls behind the lava's rise.

pages.title: Stickman Prison and Love
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Stickman Prison and Love follows a jailed stickman trying to reunite with his sweetheart. Choose tools from the package she sends and see how each decision changes the escape attempt, searching for the sequence that gets him out.

pages.title: Elemental Monsters: Merge & Evolution
pages.creator: Agava.co
pages.description: Elemental Monsters: Merge & Evolution puts fire, water, earth and air units into an army. Fight opponents to earn coins, then buy, sell and improve heroes with different combat statistics. Develop your force as you battle to free the elemental worlds.

pages.title: Black Pink Christmas Concert
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Black Pink Christmas Concert lets you dress the group's members for a holiday performance. Choose festive clothing and accessories for their stage appearances, combining the fashion options into a separate Christmas concert look for each performer.

pages.title: Make It Boom!
pages.creator: Cubehole
pages.description: Make It Boom! turns firecrackers into pieces in a chain-reaction puzzle. Tap and hold to light a firecracker, considering its timing and position so the blast reaches the others. Clear the required arrangement to finish the level.

pages.title: Slope Snowball
pages.creator: GM - Good Media
pages.description: Slope Snowball sends a snowball rolling down an endless winter course. Steer left and right to stay on the slope and avoid the hazards ahead, trying to carry the run farther before an obstacle stops it.

pages.title: Swipetown
pages.creator: Mad Data
pages.description: Swipetown combines building a fantasy village with a 2048-style board. Swipe to move every tile and merge identical buildings into new ones. Keep arranging useful pairs, because filling the board leaves no room to continue the town's growth.

pages.title: Survival Island
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Survival Island asks you to gather the resources needed to live on an island. Cut trees, mine rocks, collect grass and fish for food, then improve your abilities. Keeping your energy supplied supports further exploration and resource gathering.

pages.title: Zombie Space Episode II
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Zombie Space Episode II sends you into a space station after a lost mercenary team. Fight zombies and monsters, search boxes for weapons and look for survivors. Upgrade characters and equipment to handle the stronger threats inside the station.

pages.title: Gun Builder
pages.creator: Ohayō
pages.description: Gun Builder challenges you to survive enemies rushing toward your position. Attack the approaching group and collect helpful props to strengthen your offense. Watch the health bar during the fighting, since losing all health ends the mission.

pages.title: Mecha Duel
pages.creator: Ohayō
pages.description: Mecha Duel focuses on one-on-one fights between large robots. Follow the action prompts to launch attacks against the opposing mech, then improve your fighter for the battles ahead. Each duel tests whether your robot can defeat its next steel opponent.

pages.title: Barrel Roller - Amazing Runner
pages.creator: Tummy Games DOO
pages.description: Barrel Roller - Amazing Runner sends you down a route collecting barrels into a growing stack. Swipe sideways to gather more barrels and avoid obstacles that interfere with the pile, trying to reach the end with as much stacked as possible.

pages.title: Fruit Balls: Juicy Fusion
pages.creator: VIR Group
pages.description: Fruit Balls: Juicy Fusion asks you to drop fruits into a container and combine identical pairs. Each merge creates a larger fruit on the way toward a watermelon. Choose landing positions that support further combinations without overfilling the container.

pages.title: Blind Boat Shooting Master
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Blind Boat Shooting Master combines raft building with turn-based battles on the water. Aim and fire at rival pirates to defeat them and gather riches, developing your raft and choosing from a roster of different characters.

pages.title: Push The Colors
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Push The Colors asks you to gather cubes and push them along an obstacle course. Carry a larger stack through the color gates to gain strength for the giant waiting at the finish. Play alone or compete with a second player.

pages.title: Skibidi Toilet Shooter Chapter 1
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Skibidi Toilet Shooter Chapter 1 follows a cameraman fighting through a devastated city. Keep moving, aim at the approaching Skibidis and manage your weapons during the battle. Later levels bring enemies that are stronger and faster than the earlier attackers.

pages.title: Totally Reliable Delivery Stickman
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Totally Reliable Delivery Stickman puts a delivery worker into a world of movable objects and obstacles. Guide the character, grab the items needed for the job and carry them through the scene to work toward completing the delivery.

pages.title: Color Me
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Color Me shows a finished color pattern and asks you to reproduce it on a connected grid. Compare the example with your board and color the blocks accordingly, checking how the individual areas fit the complete image.

pages.title: Move the Rolls
pages.creator: OQTACORE Sàrl
pages.description: Move the Rolls follows a sausage climbing through a field of loaves. Push the bread aside to protect the character as it rises, reacting to the generated layout. Different skins change the character's appearance for another attempt.

pages.title: Hacker Rush
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Hacker Rush sends a character through a route filled with bitcoins, chips and police officers. Swerve to collect useful items and use the tablet for the game's bank-hacking tasks, avoiding the officers who obstruct the run.

pages.title: Animals Slide Puzzle
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Animals Slide Puzzle asks you to restore an animal picture by shifting its tiles. Click a piece beside the empty space to move it into the gap, using a sequence of moves to return the sections to their correct order.

pages.title: Driving Test Simulator
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Driving Test Simulator challenges you to reach the marked parking space without crashing. Steer the car through each three-dimensional course and make careful corrections near the destination, lining up the vehicle to complete the level.

pages.title: Tasty Candies
pages.creator: Fun Plus Studios
pages.description: Tasty Candies takes you through a farm-themed matching puzzle. Match pieces of the same color to work through its boards, using available boosters when a layout becomes harder to solve. Continue completing challenges to progress along the journey.

pages.title: Move the Dolly
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Move the Dolly gives the match-three puzzle a collection of colorful pieces to arrange. Look for useful matching sets and plan how to move the pieces into place, working through the game's puzzle challenges.

pages.title: Traffic Rider Legend
pages.creator: afewanima
pages.description: Traffic Rider Legend takes motorcycle riding onto an endless highway from a first-person viewpoint. Accelerate, brake and steer past traffic, looking for room to overtake safely. A wheelie control adds another action during the ride.

pages.title: Baby Princesses Wonderful Christmas
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Baby Princesses Wonderful Christmas lets you prepare a group of little princesses for a Christmas ball. Choose dresses, skirts, blouses and shoes for the children, coordinating their festive outfits from the wardrobe provided.

pages.title: Family Farm
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Family Farm starts with buying a plot and planting seeds from the shop. Wait for production, collect the harvest's earnings and reinvest in more crops or productivity improvements. Selling an existing crop makes room to plant a different one.

pages.title: Dalgona Memory
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Dalgona Memory hides eight types of candy shapes behind matching cards. Reveal two at a time and remember their positions to uncover pairs. Choose a game with anywhere from two to eight pairs to change the size of the challenge.

pages.title: Golf Field
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Golf Field asks you to send a golf ball into a hole through obstacle-filled levels. Work around thorns and lasers, open blocked routes and account for changes in the course's height as you line up each shot.

pages.title: Zero Numbers
pages.creator: Misc.261 Games
pages.description: Zero Numbers challenges you to eliminate every numbered tile through adjacent moves. Equal numbers disappear together, while different values combine into their sum. Plan the additions so they create the matching pairs needed to clear the field.

pages.title: Bike Stunt Driving Simulator 3D
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Bike Stunt Driving Simulator 3D puts a motorcycle through stunt missions and demanding routes. Accelerate, steer and brake through the obstacles, using nitro when a burst of speed helps. Complete the riding challenges without losing control of the bike.

pages.title: Crazy Pixel Apocalypse 3
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Crazy Pixel Apocalypse 3 brings armed players and computer-controlled enemies into block-styled arenas. Move around the map and fight with weapons ranging from axes to sniper rifles, choosing your equipment and position for the next encounter.

pages.title: Flossy & Jim Whale Tickler
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Flossy & Jim Whale Tickler gives you a cartoon whale to tickle and rub. Keep interacting until the bar fills, then watch the whale's response. The activity centers on discovering its reactions as you continue the tickling.

pages.title: Chain Cube 2048 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Chain Cube 2048 3D lets you shoot numbered cubes into a three-dimensional play area. Combine matching values into larger cubes and plan placements that allow further merges, working toward creating a cube numbered 2048.

pages.title: Princess Magic Christmas DIY
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Princess Magic Christmas DIY follows princesses making homemade Christmas decorations. Work through virtual craft activities, creating decorative snow and using it to dress up a jar as a holiday lamp. Finish the projects with the game's selected materials.

pages.title: Sweet Candy Halloween
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Sweet Candy Halloween asks you to swap neighboring tiles into matching rows. Align at least three identical pieces to remove them and continue through the Halloween-themed challenges, looking for moves that create another useful group.

pages.title: Mahjong Halloween
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Mahjong Halloween challenges you to clear paired tiles before the timer expires. Select two matching tiles to remove them and uncover more choices in the layout. Keep finding available pairs until the entire arrangement is gone.

pages.title: Summer Cars Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Summer Cars Memory hides car pictures behind face-down tiles across four levels. Reveal two at a time and remember their locations to find identical pairs. Clear every pair while trying to finish in fewer moves.

pages.title: Chef Kids
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Chef Kids puts a group of hungry children in charge of the kitchen. Help them prepare food through cooking and baking activities, choosing what to make for themselves and their friends. Their kitchen adventure also includes a food fight.

pages.title: Extreme Impossible Monster Truck
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Extreme Impossible Monster Truck takes a large stunt vehicle onto narrow, demanding tracks. Steer through the mountain course and tackle its obstacles, using the room available to keep the truck controlled through each driving challenge.

pages.title: Color Catch
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Color Catch asks you to match a ball's color as it enters a circle. Tap the corresponding color button at the right moment, watching the next approach carefully as you try to keep the sequence going and improve your score.

pages.title: Candy Cube
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Candy Cube fills its play area with descending candy blocks that need to be destroyed. Slide left and right and time the double-tap action to clear the candies, trying to keep the area from filling while increasing your score.

pages.title: Trailer Cargo Truck Offroad Transporter
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Trailer Cargo Truck Offroad Transporter puts you in charge of a long cargo trailer on off-road routes. Use the truck's steering and gears to negotiate the terrain, handling its length carefully as you complete the transport levels.

pages.title: Coronavirus Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Coronavirus Slide turns three themed images into sliding-tile puzzles. Choose an image and one of three modes, then rearrange the sections to reconstruct the picture. Plan how the available space lets you reposition each tile.

pages.title: Road Racer Furious Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Road Racer Furious Game sends a car along a highway in an arcade racing challenge. Control its movement as the road continues ahead, keeping the vehicle on course while working through the drive at speed.

pages.title: Day At School My Teacher Games
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Day At School My Teacher Games follows the activities of a classroom's first day back. Take the teacher's role and guide the students through the school-day tasks, completing the game's different levels as the class gets underway.

pages.title: Phantom Golf Driver
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Phantom Golf Driver offers customizable cars and a map designed for stunts. Choose a vehicle and one of three modes, then explore the driving area and try its obstacles. The handbrake and camera controls help position the car for maneuvers.

pages.title: City Driving Truck Simulator 3D
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: City Driving Truck Simulator 3D asks you to pick up loads and deliver them around a city. Start the engine, follow each mission and reach the destination before time becomes a problem. Successful deliveries earn money and help unlock more trucks.

pages.title: Ricocheting Ball
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Ricocheting Ball places a bouncing ball inside a circle with no solid boundary. Move the platform around its edge to intercept the ball whenever it approaches. Keep returning the ball inward to prevent it from escaping.

pages.title: Cartoon Farm Differences
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Cartoon Farm Differences presents two versions of a farm picture with small changes between them. Compare the scenes and select each detail that differs, searching the animals, objects and background until you have found the required changes.

pages.title: Forge Ahead
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Forge Ahead lets you make swords and improve your workshop. Work the metal with the hammer to shape a blade, then sell the completed sword. Use the money to upgrade equipment and continue producing new weapons.

pages.title: Turn Based Ship war
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Turn Based Ship war gives you alternating cannon shots against an enemy ship. Hold to set the firing angle and release to shoot, then wait through the opponent's attack. Adjust your aim so your ship survives longer than its rival.

pages.title: Moto Road Rash 3D
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Moto Road Rash 3D lets you ride a motorcycle through road traffic. Accelerate, brake and steer into gaps as you overtake other vehicles, keeping control at speed. Choose a bike from the garage before heading onto the road.

pages.title: Tower of Hanoi 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Tower of Hanoi 3D challenges you to transfer a stack of disks from the left rod to the right. Move one disk at a time, always keeping larger disks underneath smaller ones. Use the middle rod to arrange the necessary transfers.

pages.title: Tonball
pages.creator: sienar games
pages.description: Tonball makes you launch a ball by adjusting a weight. Hold the mouse to change how far the throw travels, judging the distance to the target. Get the ball through the pot before the timer expires.

pages.title: Mouse Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Mouse Jigsaw lets you assemble mouse pictures at three difficulty settings. Finish puzzles to earn in-game currency and unlock further images, with harder modes awarding more. Drag the scattered sections into position to complete each picture.

pages.title: Monster Truck Rider
pages.creator: Darko Veljovic
pages.description: Monster Truck Rider sends a truck across twelve obstacle courses. Accelerate and adjust the vehicle's balance as its wheels climb over the terrain, aiming to finish every level without losing control of the truck.

pages.title: Gibbets Master
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Gibbets Master asks you to rescue people by shooting the ropes above them. Aim arrows carefully to cut each rope without striking the person, and finish the rescue before time runs out. The game contains fifty increasingly demanding levels.

pages.title: Stunt Car Escape Drive
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Stunt Car Escape Drive puts a car on roads filled with moving mechanical hazards. Steer around hammers, flails and gates while judging the gaps between their movements. Use the handbrake and camera views to help negotiate the dangerous course.

pages.title: Tower Of Babel
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Tower Of Babel asks you to place building blocks into an ever-higher tower. Tap when the next section is lined up with the stack, keeping the structure balanced as it grows. Higher placements make accuracy increasingly difficult.

pages.title: Racing Car Game Bomb
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Racing Car Game Bomb takes traffic driving onto busy highways with several game modes. Steer around other vehicles to keep the run going and build your score, trying standard road challenges or the game's bomb mode.

pages.title: EG Penguin Adventure
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Penguin Adventure follows a penguin facing alien monsters across an adventure course. Slide and jump through obstacles, fire at enemies and use cannons or rockets to fly through parts of the route as you continue onward.

pages.title: High Road
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: High Road lets you choose a sports car and race through three-dimensional pixel-styled scenery. Steer along the course and handle the changing road as you drive, working to keep the selected car moving smoothly through the race.

pages.title: Plasticine Bubbles
pages.creator: Rumata Lab
pages.description: Plasticine Bubbles is a platform puzzle about bringing two clay-like characters together. Shed some of your character's body to move faster and jump higher, using the size change to reach the other bubble across the stage.

pages.title: Ninja Run
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Ninja Run challenges you to keep a ninja moving past a sequence of obstacles. Time jumps and double jumps to clear the next hazard, extending the run to increase your score and work toward unlockable characters.

pages.title: Red Carpet Fashion
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Red Carpet Fashion lets you prepare girls for a red-carpet appearance. Choose clothing and accessories from the available fashion items, combining the pieces into a finished outfit for each character attending the event.

pages.title: Princess Sorority Pledges
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess Sorority Pledges follows Elsa, Anna, Ariel and Jasmine trying to join a college sorority. Complete Maleficent's pledges through outfit choices, painting and photo-design activities, helping the princesses work through the requirements set for them.

pages.title: BFF Princess Career Photoshoot
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: BFF Princess Career Photoshoot helps Rapunzel and Moana try out future professions before graduation. Choose a career for each princess and dress her in the corresponding clothes, then arrange the trial photoshoot that shows the selected role.

pages.title: Street Dance Fashion Style
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Street Dance Fashion Style puts you in charge of outfits for a dance competition. Choose clothes for the first girl, then style the others, coordinating a set of street-dance looks for the group's appearance at the event.

pages.title: Snake Blast
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Snake Blast follows a hungry snake through a field shared with other snakes. Guide it toward food while steering clear of the other bodies, choosing a route that keeps your snake feeding without colliding with its rivals.

pages.title: Linker Hero
pages.creator: littlegiantworld
pages.description: Linker Hero turns chains of colored orbs into actions during Elucard's adventure. Connect same-colored orbs to attack, defend, heal or use magic, choosing the support your hero needs for each encounter on the journey toward Dracurius.

pages.title: Falling Orbs
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Falling Orbs challenges you to move a small character clear of orb enemies. Steer left and right to avoid collisions, collecting time bonuses and diamonds during the round. Keep the character moving safely to improve the score.

pages.title: DJ Shaq
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: DJ Shaq gives you a music-making setup for experimenting with beats and sounds. Try the available musical elements and combine them into a mix, changing the selections to create your own rhythm through the game's controls.

pages.title: Rock Hero
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Rock Hero turns a stream of musical notes into a timing challenge. Play the notes as they arrive and keep up with the sequence. Missing three notes ends the attempt, so concentrate on the next beat as you continue.

pages.title: Girls New Fashion Boutique
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Girls New Fashion Boutique follows a group of friends visiting a new clothing shop. Browse the dresses on sale and select an outfit for each girl, combining your fashion choices into looks for their shopping day together.

pages.title: One More Flight
pages.creator: Ozdy
pages.description: One More Flight asks you to guide a small plane toward the final checkpoint while collecting stars. Keep it clear of everything in the flight path, adjusting its route around obstacles. A crash sends you back for another attempt.

pages.title: Madelyn Dental Care
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Madelyn Dental Care puts you in charge of helping Madelyn clean her teeth. Use the available dental-care items to work through the cleaning activity, then choose clothing and a hair accessory to finish her look after the visit.

pages.title: Ellie and Annie Movie Night!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Ellie and Annie Movie Night! lets you dress two princesses for a trip to the cinema. Browse the available clothes and put together a separate outfit for each sister, getting them ready for their evening movie plans.

pages.title: Santas Last Minute Presents
pages.creator: UncertainStudio
pages.description: Santas Last Minute Presents asks you to time Santa's gift drops from above the rooftops. Release each present when it can fall into a chimney, watching Santa's movement so the next delivery reaches its intended opening.
